user_authorization: 重新授权一次连接诊断不成功就决定换源
quota: exclusive file creation and durable reservation before dispatch; existing, partial, corrupt, failed or unknown reservation is permanently consumed
old_journal_access: read-only hashes before and after; never reset, delete or mutate
payload_retention: RAM-only; closed sanitized diagnostic and quota metadata only
acceptance: COMPLETE login with one validated response and all cleanup checks true; no market-data or freshness claim
failure_action: FAILED or UNKNOWN retires BaoStock from the active candidate plan; documentation-only replacement research, no replacement-source probe
success_action: report this one successful login only; no market query, automatic repair or Phase B
product_permissions: unchanged and closed; old P4D pipeline remains blocked for either outcome
review: independent entry and Prompt Auditor before implementation; actual independent read-only Reviewer and separate Release Checker on the new exact operation snapshot before dispatch
historical_validation: Prior 197 governance and 854 product results remain historical only; no claim of rerun. Product and old checker/test bytes must remain identical to baseline.
entry_semantics: This explicit supplemental operation entry supersedes the old path allowlist only for these named additions and two documentation paths. It does not make old governance.py check/gate pass or authorize an old runtime entry.
publication: Local checkpoint only; no push, PR, CI, merge or product release. A later source-selection package must reconcile the main construction entry and CI before publication.
rollback: Close socket, dispose RAM payloads, retain consumed quota and failure evidence; never retry or reset
next_gate: Stop BaoStock if unsuccessful; otherwise report connectivity only. Both outcomes require a separately reviewed next construction package.
